description: Add, change, complete or reopen a task in DayHeart. add needs a title (date and time optional; time needs a date). update changes the title, date, time, length, important or urgent. complete marks the task done; reopen marks it not done. Notes and private tasks are not available.

action.description: What to do with the task

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; empty string removes the date

duration_minutes.description: How long the task takes, 1 to 1440 minutes; only with a time

id.description: Task id, for update, complete and reopen

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour; needs a date; empty string removes the time

title.description: What to do, up to 180 characters

name: change_tasks
title: Change tasks
